title: In God's Eternity
description: In God's Eternity in Tonic Solfa to BOYLSTON, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Hosea Ballou wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 294 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Universal Redemption”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to BOYLSTON; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: In God's e-ter-ni-ty There shall a day a-rise, When all the race of man shall be With Je-sus in the skies.

lines: When all the race of man shall be
Sin shall retire before the blaze
A ceaseless song of praise begin,

licence: Public domain: Hosea Ballou died in 1852.
credits: Words by Hosea Ballou (1771–1852), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to BOYLSTON by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
